exposure: Antenatal corticosteroid treatment during the late-preterm period
outcome: Composite neonatal respiratory morbidity (respiratory distress syndrome, mechanical ventilation, surfactant administration, transferred with respiratory complications, neonatal death)
cohort: The study included 1974 individuals with twin pregnancies delivered between February 2013 and September 2020, who were at risk for late preterm birth (34 weeks and 0 days to 36 weeks and 6 days of gestation).
finding: The study found insufficient evidence that antenatal corticosteroid treatment during the late-preterm period in twin pregnancies was associated with a lower risk of composite neonatal respiratory morbidity.
gest_age: 34 weeks and 0 days to 36 weeks and 6 days of gestation
